candidates.question: A Cosmos DB account uses Session consistency. API instance A commits a document write; the caller’s next point read may run on instance B, whose client has not observed that partition’s session state. Account-wide stronger consistency is not part of the design. Which handoff meets this caller’s read-your-writes requirement?
correctAnswerText: Pass the relevant write’s session token to B for the subsequent read.
candidates.subskill: Optimize query performance and Request Units (RUs) consumption by using indexing policies and consistency levels

candidates.question: A PostgreSQL team budgets the next vector-corpus release using only row count × dimensions × four bytes. Its existing database also has vector indexes, frequent embedding replacements, and a growing corpus. It must reserve capacity for the live database, not just export the current vector values. Which budgeting basis addresses all three omitted consumers?
correctAnswerText: Measured table/index sizes plus projected growth and update/maintenance headroom.
candidates.subskill: Configure compute, memory, and storage resources to support vector workloads

candidates.question: An Azure Managed Redis client uses OSS clustering. A feature must retain a single MGET for several related string keys, but their current slot distribution causes CROSSSLOT. The deployment must remain OSS and the one-command interface is fixed. Which redesign satisfies both constraints?
correctAnswerText: Arrange the participating keys so they map to one hash slot.

candidates.question: A Cosmos DB API is migrating from a category/date ordering to a category/priority ordering. Old instances remain live during a rolling deployment. The new composite is being added but its transformation is incomplete; removal of the old index would affect the old instances immediately. Which rollout preserves index support through the transition?
correctAnswerText: Finish the new transformation, switch query traffic, then remove the old composite after old instances drain.

candidates.question: A Python maintenance job is scheduled by an existing batch orchestrator. candidates.question: An established PostgreSQL IVFFlat cosine index has 100 lists.
